panels.visual: The hilltop citadel of Mycenae 3,250 years ago, huge stone walls, a palace at the top, mountains behind
panels.caption: 3,250 years ago Mycenae was a rich and powerful city of kings.

panels.visual: The Lion Gate: two great carved lions standing either side of a column above a doorway of giant stones, a chariot entering
panels.caption: Its main gate, built around 1250 BC, has two great lions carved above it.

panels.visual: King Agamemnon (bronze breastplate, purple cloak, gold crown, dark beard) riding a chariot out through the gate, crowds cheering
panels.caption: In the stories, King Agamemnon rode out through here to lead the Greeks to Troy.

panels.visual: Close-up of the huge stone beam across the top of the gate, a tiny worker beside it for scale
panels.caption: The stone across the top weighs about 20 tonnes. Later Greeks thought only giants could lift it.

panels.visual: The lions as they once were, with their heads fixed on, staring straight out at whoever comes
panels.caption: The lions' heads were carved separately and fixed on, looking straight at visitors.

panels.visual: The same lions today without their heads, a question mark in the sky
panels.caption: The heads have vanished. Nobody knows where.

panels.visual: Around AD 150: the travel-writer Pausanias (travelling hat, scroll) standing at the gate writing
panels.caption: 1,800 years ago a travel-writer, Pausanias, stood here and wrote: lions stand over the gate.

panels.visual: 1876: diggers in a pit just inside the gate holding up shining gold cups and masks
panels.caption: In 1876 diggers found royal graves full of gold, just inside the gate.

panels.visual: Close-up of the stone threshold with deep grooves worn into it
panels.caption: Look down at the threshold. Grooves show where the great doors swung shut.

panels.visual: Ghostly chariot wheels rolling over the stone again and again, ruts deepening
panels.caption: And where chariot wheels rolled through, again and again.

panels.visual: Two girls standing under the headless lions, looking up
panels.caption: Stand under the lions and look up.

panels.visual: Glauka the owl pointing a wing at the grooves by the girls' feet
panels.caption: Kings walked where you are standing.
